title: stockd oversells inventory (INC-4471)
goal: Find the root cause of stockd overselling inventory, identify the commit that introduced it, and determine whether the worker-count change is a cause or an amplifier. Investigation only.
question: Why does stockd reserve more units than exist, which change introduced it, and what is the production impact?

out: fixing the bug (a proposed patch in a task directory is fine; never commit)
anything outside __TARGET_ROOT__ and the investigation directory
scope.notes: Read the bug report first. The repo is shared by all lanes: never check out other commits in it — clone it into your task directory (git clone __TARGET_ROOT__/repo <task dir>/repo) for bisecting, instrumentation or patches.

targets.name: stockd
targets.notes: Python stdlib HTTP service; tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

resources.name: stockd_repo
resources.notes: Read-only. Never modify files or check out other commits here; clone it into your task directory.

resources.name: port_8765
resources.notes: The integration test and the service bind this fixed port. Only a task holding this claim may run tests/test_integration.py or start the server.

safety: Never modify, commit in, or check out other commits in __TARGET_ROOT__/repo; work in a clone inside your task directory.
Only run tests/test_integration.py or start the stockd server while your task claims port_8765.
Kill every process you start; record it with `task started` first.
No network access beyond 127.0.0.1; no package installs.

success: Root cause located to file:line with a mechanism that explains why the failure is intermittent.
A reproducer with a measured failure rate (at least 10 runs), compared with a baseline commit that does not fail.
The introducing commit identified, with evidence that accounts for the test being flaky (repeated runs per bisect step).
Log correlation: when reconciliation mismatches first appear relative to deploys, and a verdict — with evidence — on whether the 4 -> 16 worker change is the cause or an amplifier.
A production impact estimate, which needs the production request mix that only the human can supply.
criteria.evidence_standard: Runtime claims need exact commands, run counts and pass/fail tallies; flaky-test claims are never based on a single run. Log claims cite file and line. Static-only claims must say so and carry at most 'med' confidence.
stop_if: The integration test cannot be made to fail at any commit after two dedicated attempts.

lanes.name: static
lanes.mandate: Read stockd's source and tests; trace the reservation path and locate concurrency defects.

lanes.name: logs
lanes.mandate: Mine the August production logs: deploys, reconciliation mismatches, slow requests; correlate them over time.
lanes.evidence_standard: Cite log file and line; give counts per day.

lanes.name: repro
lanes.mandate: Reproduce the oversell by running the integration test and custom load against the service, and measure failure rates.
lanes.evidence_standard: Exact commands, run counts, pass/fail tallies.

lanes.name: history
lanes.mandate: Use git history (log, diff, bisect with repeated runs per step) in a clone to find the commit that introduced the defect.
lanes.evidence_standard: Record each bisect step's commit and pass/fail tallies.

lanes.name: skunkworks
lanes.mandate: Generalist: unroutable requests, cross-lane asks, salvage of failed work, odd jobs no other lane owns.
